title: Independent Stage68 exact CW32R031C8U6 LSI metadata, data projection and HAL build-qualification review
scope: Read-only own-source, policy, electrical digest, generator admission and HAL build qualification review. This is not full implementation/runtime, clean-replay, hardware, RF-continuity or publication acceptance.

native_factory_read.evidence: Own RM PDF56/58/73 and SDK RCC_LSI_Enable native uint16_t load; raw erased-halfword refusal remains conservative software policy.

own_source_review.page_review: Own DS PDF9/11/14/16/35/40/42/54, RM clock/calibration/gates/selectors/consumer pages and SDK/PDSC were reopened. The 25 C accuracy row, trim adjustability and RF 250 kbps temperature row do not replace the MCU LSI envelope.
own_source_review.visual_evidence: Viewed retained renders of own RM PDF49 clock tree, PDF498 RF block diagram and PDF143 PB11 AF table.
own_source_review.rf_positive_graph: Dedicated external 16 MHz crystal feeds RFCLK and separate RF synthesizer. MCU SYSCLK through divided PCLK and SYSCTRL.AHBEN.GPIOA reaches PA00=MISO, PA01=MOSI, PA02=SCK, PA03=CS. RF-owned XTAL_OCLK /1,/2,/4,/8 may feed MCU HSE bypass through a board connection. Whole-bank handover and continued inherited source availability remain visible functional conditions; no RF runtime probe or continuity claim is added.

policy_and_generator_findings: All six existing family YAML blocks are byte-identical. Only the introductory scope sentence and appended independently sourced R031 family policy change.
Electrical YAML changes only the LSI policy SHA-256. The digest matches. Existing RTC, HSI/LSE policies, parts, source lock and field-access inputs are byte-identical.

The exact family roster adds only CW32R031. Shared-IP identity is insufficient: R031 has its own literal exact1 package, memory, source/hash/page, calibration, voltage, temperature, RF, register/access, gate and base bindings.

Recursive duplicate-key rejection remains via serde_yaml::Value. R031 still starts with null family electrical capability; every qualification check precedes the sole exact-part SYSCTRL injection. Generic R031 receives structural validation but no injection, and W031 remains unqualified.

All 53 literal field identities and own position/width/access values match the independent SVD parse. Exact complete-set comparison rejects omissions/substitutions/duplicates; IR validation checks readable scalar 32-bit registers, unique names, fieldsets and scalar field shapes.

KEY WO and source STABLE RO evidence is independently bound because IR does not retain all field access. The existing four native STABLE overlay entries remain unique and unchanged; no PAC setter or access delta is introduced.

All nine native SYSCTRL enable/reset pairs, offsets, bits, single-bit shapes, active-high enables, active-low resets, unkeyed protocol and GPIO work-gate classification are bound. UART and GPIO ordered rosters remain complete.

Ten bases, SYSCTRL IRQ4, IER/ISR LSIRDY and separate LSI/ISR stable views are bound. PB11 AF1, conservative non-LSI AF set and exact QFN48 pin25 are retained, with PF0/PF1 pins4/5 and PC14/PC15 pins2/3 independently checked.
Dedicated RC10K watchdog, VC PCLK/RC150K and LVD HSIOSC/RC150K facts remain distinct. Absences refer to MCU system PLL/HEX/AUTOTRIM/LCD/LPTIM and explicitly preserve the separate RF PLL.

R031 qualification values equal existing own RTC facts. RTC metadata bytes are unchanged; the exact new capability makes factory-LSI aliases rate-only under every SYSCLK through the existing bound path.

The shared native validator preserves every prior L031 exact3 roster, voltage, source/hash/page, memory, PB11 unbonded exception, observer, consumer and conservative-policy comparison. The F002/F003 validator and tests tail is byte-identical. New R031-only checks are false for old branches.

hal_build_qualification.diff: Only three planned admission/coexistence edits: pair line/name for native LSI generation, pair line/name for LSE/LSI capability equivalence, and replace the inner L031 assertion with the exact paired predicate.

r031_helper.span: RCC_LSI_PARAMETERS_MASK through the end of rcc_factory_lsi_consumers, immediately before RCC_HSE_CRYSTAL_RANGE_HZ

hal_build_qualification.negative_and_unchanged_sites: Generic R031 and exact W031 actual cfg/helper outputs remain negative. Separate L010/L011/L012 null assertions, classic paths, L052/L083 coexistence, HEX emission and all other admission sites are unchanged.

sole_semantic_delta.after: Exact own R031 factory-LSI qualification from policy

generated_projection.sole_metapac_change: None becomes the exact PeripheralLsiSysclk object; removing this insertion reconstructs the old file byte-for-byte.

verification_limits: Reviewer executed read-only text/XML/YAML/JSON/archive inspection, hashing and comparison, and wrote only review artifacts outside source.

Reviewer ran no Cargo, generation, HAL test, probe, executable runtime model, hardware action, network or source edit. Coordinator-owned generated outputs and six completed library records were inspected as evidence.

Full finite main ELF/build acceptance, frozen shared runtime acceptance, final source packaging and clean replay have separate receipts. This metadata acceptance does not assert those tasks are complete.
Any change to the four frozen functional files or reviewed generated projections requires rereview. Later review-document-only packaging does not alter this scoped disposition.
